ios.description: Space Dodger is a thrilling mobile game that blends classic arcade action with modern features. Pilot your spaceship through hazardous asteroid fields, collect valuable coins, and aim for the highest score.
ios.full_description: Space Dodger is a thrilling mobile game that blends classic arcade action with modern features. Pilot your spaceship through hazardous asteroid fields, collect valuable coins, and aim for the highest score. Customize your gameplay experience with a range of settings and difficulty levels, making each run uniquely challenging and fun.
